description_en: Queries a list of data sources
name: ListConnections

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所在的工作空间ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source to query
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the connection string. Valid values:
odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.help_zh:

odps

rds

parameters.name: connection_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the connection string. This parameter applies to scenarios where a parent type contains subtypes. The following combinations are supported:
Parent type: `rds`
Subtypes: `mysql`, `sqlserver`, or `postgresql`
parameters.help_zh:
连接串的子类型，针对某些父类型type中包含子类型的场景。目前有以下组合：
父类型：`rds`
子类型：`mysql`、 `sqlserver`或 `postgresql`
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:
ENABLED: Normal.
DISABLED: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的状态。
ENABLED 正常
DISABLED 禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The environment to which the data source belongs. Valid values:
0: Development environment.
1: Production environment
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所属的环境，包括0（开发环境）和1（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number for the paging query. Valid values: integers greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询页码。取值为大于等于1的正整数
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The paging query results of the connection strings
Data.description_zh: 连接串的分页查询结果

DefaultEngine.description_en: Indicates whether the engine associated with the data source is the default engine of the same type
DefaultEngine.description_zh: 数据源关联的引擎是否为同类型下的默认引擎

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

EnvType.description_en:
The environment where the data source resides. Valid values:
0: Development environment.
1: Production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
数据源所在的环境。
0  开发环境
1 生产环境

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was modified. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

Operator.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud user who last modified the data source
Operator.description_zh: 最近一次修改数据源的阿里云用户ID

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace associated with the data source
ProjectId.description_zh: 数据源关联的工作空间ID

Sequence.description_en: The sort field. Data sources are sorted in descending order based on this field
Sequence.description_zh: 排序字段。数据源按此字段从大到小排序

Shared.description_en: Indicates whether the data source is shared

Status.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:
1: Normal.
2: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
数据源的状态。
1 正常
2 禁用

SubType.description_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter applies to scenarios where a parent type contains subtypes. The following combinations are supported:
Parent type: `rds`
Subtypes: `mysql`, `sqlserver`, or `postgresql`
SubType.description_zh:
数据源的子类型。针对某些父类型type中包含子类型的场景。目前有以下组合：
父类型：`rds`
子类型：`mysql`、`sqlserver`或`postgresql`

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data sources

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
